facts.text: Jim Dear dunking a doughnut at breakfast
facts.why: None of the sources I opened show Jim Dear dunking a doughnut. The plot opens with him giving Darling the hatbox at Christmas.
facts.fix: Jim Dear giving Darling the hatbox on Christmas morning

vibe.verdict: Charming and close to the film, with Tony calling Tramp Butch and the candlelit plate front and centre.
missing: Bella Notte on the accordion (Tony and Joe serenade)
Si and Am the Siamese cats (Aunt Sarah)
The zoo and the muzzle (Tramp frees Lady)
The pound (the stray dogs and Peg)
ideas: Swap 'Cold milk' note 'A tall glass, or a saucer' for 'For Si and Am, not allowed back here'.
Swap 'Espresso' for 'Bella Notte Espresso', with a tiny accordion picture.
Add 'Tonight Butch gets the best in the house' in place of 'Regulars at the back door eat free'.
Swap 'Breadsticks' note for 'Long enough to meet in the middle'.
